B1_single_layer_larger_segment.reason: The measured intervals contain required HyperConnection, projection, residual, route/resident/merge, QSA/GDN state work and queued NPU execution. No measured removable launch-only slice reaches the 15% complete-layer gate. Treating the full interval as removable would be invalid.

B2_expanded_cross_submodule_segment.reason: An exact design needs bounded graph instances for per-layer weights, mutable KV/QSA/GDN/PLE state generations, dynamic route tensors and a fresh CPU work ID on every token, with CPU kept outside capture. That graph-cache/state-address architecture does not exist in the frozen runtime and is beyond a bounded final-round implementation.

historical_causal_check.conclusion: A graph can speed a small captured child while leaving the request critical path essentially unchanged.

interpretation: This rejects the two bounded Round17 segment designs; it does not claim a new runtime-wide exact decoder graph is impossible.
